description: This file declares the H4Packetizer class, which handles socket-based H4 packetization for Bluetooth communication, including methods for sending data and handling incoming data on Unix systems.

classes.name: H4Packetizer
classes.description: A class that manages socket-based H4 packetization, providing methods to send data and process incoming data, with callbacks for different packet types and disconnection events.

methods.name: H4Packetizer
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the packetizer with file descriptor and callback functions.

methods.name: Send
methods.description: Sends data of a specific type over the socket.

methods.name: OnDataReady
methods.description: Handles incoming data when the socket has data ready to be read.
